question: This morning's census cut the gap to 90 with WB8 in flight. WB8 has LANDED (trust 54fa5a0174), the trust main line moved on through the write!-chain lowering, a SHA-2 dependency swap, a trust-verify repair, a tree-wide reformat and a tidy, and the clean corpus gained the nat_gcd loop respell, ContainerMap synthesis and C.rel. What is the tip x tip gap, channel by channel — and does O3flips == O0flips ∩ markers_exact still hold as an EQUALITY?

provenance.method: TWO sealed drivers from DETACHED trust worktrees, each whole-crate clean-kernel at -O3 / -O0 / -O3+noflip control (-Ztrust-ir-flip=no), each run against two corpora. Five measured points form a ladder where every adjacent step moves exactly ONE of {producer, corpus}; rows joined by def_index within a compile pair and by def_path (multiset) across pairs. The tip x tip point (g4t) is the census; the others are the attribution.

the_tip_is_unbuildable_AGAIN.finding: trust origin/main is UNBUILDABLE from a613e62eb0 onward — not a lock this time, a MISSING SOURCE FILE. a613e62eb0 ("tidy: six debt layers closed", 18:24 PDT; its own follow-up 50d77a069f says the R1 structural-recursion payload was swept into it by an over-broad `git add -u`) adds `pub mod reflect_rec;` (lib.rs:187) and `pub use reflect_rec::reflect_structural_rec;` (lib.rs:204) to crates/trust-clean-origin/src/lib.rs, and emit.rs:2277 calls it, but crates/trust-clean-origin/src/reflect_rec.rs was never committed: absent from every tree that declares it, not gitignored (check-ignore: no match), absent from the shared checkout too. Every commit with a613e62eb0 as an ancestor fails `cargo build --locked` with error[E0583] in trust-clean-origin: b98d319357, 3a66b4349c, 41e35d4201, 50d77a069f, 6b0f9c0a7b, 109d7f2363 (the tip when this lane started) and 11a8e1877a (the tip at census time).

the_tip_is_unbuildable_AGAIN.newest_buildable_slice: 239d046966 (18:29 PDT, `Merge origin/main into HEAD`) — the maximal commit in d7a4c69e45..tip WITHOUT a613e62eb0 as an ancestor: it carries 17 of the range's 25 commits (write!-chain lowering bd99c36cd6, PtrData respelling ab32c045eb, Trust-owned SHA-2 swap ab1c30c09e, ay-pin advance c185305cfe, trust-verify repair 7a95c4f75b, quarantine retirement 12a865d9ea, len-summary/fatptr/vecdeque bridge merges); what it does NOT carry is exactly the broken line: 9fc06acc40 (the tree-wide reformat, a613e62eb0's parent, on a side branch off 9e5ea7b35d) and everything above it.
the_tip_is_unbuildable_AGAIN.what_the_unbuildable_line_would_add_to_t: formatting only. trustfmt (stage0, rustfmt.toml at the tip, skip_children for the two lib.rs) applied to BOTH revisions of every lowering-path file that differs between d7a4c69e45 and 109d7f2363 gives byte-identical output (see coordination.producer_motion_to_the_literal_tip_is_it_formatting); to_mir.rs, flip_registry.rs, mir_differential.rs, crate_module.rs, differential.rs and trust_ir_flip.rs are raw-blob-identical.
